name: background-cubes-grid
title: Background Cubes Grid
description: A full-bleed three.js background of a tilted grid of cubes. Moving the pointer sends glowing orange waves rippling across the surface, which settles flat and then drops idle ripples on its own.
use: A hero or landing page wants an interactive tech backdrop that responds to the pointer without taking over.
avoid: It is a heavy WebGL scene running every frame and has no touch hover, so it is a poor fit for low-end mobile.
a11y: Marked aria-hidden and decorative, and idle ripples switch off under reduced motion, but pointer ripples still animate. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A dark full-bleed field of small rounded cubes in a receding perspective grid, catching warm orange light on raised crests while the rest stays near-black. A white heading and a small badge sit over it.
behaves: Moving the cursor pushes a ripple through the cubes; a ring of raised, orange-lit blocks spreads out, passes on, and the surface settles flat. After a quiet moment it starts dropping its own random ripples.
customise: Variant, grid size, gap, base, wave and background colours, glow, amplitude, tilt and idle ripples are props. The demo headline and badge are separate, not part of the effect.
weight: heavy: A three.js instanced cube scene with post-processing renders every frame while waves move.
demo: Badge Realtime infrastructure, headline Every event, felt across the grid, and a line about 1,936 live nodes.
issues: The white heading overlaps the brightest orange crests, which lowers contrast in some frames.
Idle ripples keep the scene animating indefinitely, so the renderer never fully sleeps.
polishWhy: Striking, well-tuned wave physics and glow; the headline text fights the brightest crests.
